title: OTA Tutorial: A Short Discussion of the LM13600/LM13700
summary: Gene Zumchak's classic tutorial on operational transconductance amplifiers, hosted on René Schmitz's site: how the OTA works as a controllable amplifier and how the LM13600/LM13700 extend the CA3080.
